title: Concept: npm registry token in a response
description: An .npmrc line that sets a registry authentication token in a response gives every reader the same visibility the bank has internally: The token authenticates publishes and installs against the registry, so a page that prints it hands over the ability to publish packages under the organisation's scope.
applicability: A publish-capable token lets an attacker ship a malicious version of a package that internal teams install.
risk: The token is a bearer credential for the registry and cannot be scoped by the page that leaks it.
